definitions: Shape or form (a soft substance) into a particular shape or form.
Influence the formation or development of (a person's character, attitudes, or beliefs).
Form (an object) out of a soft or molten substance by pressing it into a mould.
Be formed or shaped in a mould.
examples: She moulded the clay into a small figure.
The plastic is moulded into various shapes.
The jelly moulded perfectly in the dish.
